GeneDef.label: nanite body
GeneDef.description: A synthetic humanoid body maintained by coordinated nanomachines. It keeps an ordinary Food need as feedstock intake while rapidly clearing food poisoning and supporting WNG nanite reconstruction.

GeneDef.label: nanite reserve
GeneDef.description: A visible reserve of converted feedstock used by accelerated nanite repair and high-cost reconstruction. Eating replenishes the reserve; ordinary passage of time does not consume it.
GeneDef.resourceDescription: Stored nanite feedstock used by reconstruction and human-form fabrication.

GeneDef.label: nanite reconstruction
GeneDef.description: Coordinated repair nanites heal ordinary injuries rapidly while reserve remains, fall back to slower emergency repair when depleted, and can reconstruct missing anatomy on a much longer cycle.

GeneDef.label: EMP-sensitive nanites
GeneDef.description: The body's distributed nanite coordination is vulnerable to EMP. A successful EMP hit temporarily pauses nanite reconstruction instead of being ignored by a human-shaped synthetic.

GeneDef.label: nanite neural interface
GeneDef.description: A structured synthetic neural interface for direct allegiance/custody rewriting, skill-pattern acquisition and human-form copy assembly.

GeneDef.label: collective lattice link
GeneDef.description: A persistent identity link used by Asuran and human-form Replicator collective systems. It marks a unit as part of the synthetic lattice without making it a Replicator Queen.

GeneDef.label: sovereign replicator lattice
GeneDef.description: The unique sovereign coordination lattice of the Replicator Queen. This marker is never part of the ordinary human-form Replicator xenotype and grants direct command authority over base/block Replicators.
